text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Linton Avenue, between Victoria Park Avenue and Blantyre Avenue from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Linton Avenue to accommodate their long-term parking needs.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized parking by permit only on a street name basis, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on both sides of Linton Avenue, between Victoria Park Avenue and Blantyre Avenue.
